answer: Reaching eligibility takes 51 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an attacker pays for every seat it wants. The signal register is checked at draw time, jade lists the eligible set, and dawn seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 51 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. A 289 account operation therefore ties up 8 million dollars of idle capital. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
